v4_wrappers.install:
#!/bin/sh
set +e
/usr/local/bin/node /tools/package/bin/pnpm.cjs install --offline --ignore-scripts --ignore-pnpmfile --frozen-lockfile --store-dir /cache/store --package-import-method=copy
code=$?
set -e
mkdir -p "$NEXUS_OUTPUT_DIR/checks"
printf '{"command_key":"install","exit_code":%s,"scope":"local_mechanical_only"}\n' "$code" >"$NEXUS_OUTPUT_DIR/checks/install.json"
exit "$code"
v4_wrappers.build:
#!/bin/sh
set +e
/usr/local/bin/node /tools/package/bin/pnpm.cjs --filter @stockflow/web build
code=$?
set -e
mkdir -p "$NEXUS_OUTPUT_DIR/checks"
printf '{"command_key":"build","exit_code":%s,"scope":"local_mechanical_only"}\n' "$code" >"$NEXUS_OUTPUT_DIR/checks/build.json"
exit "$code"
